grammar.title: 过去简单时 vs 过去进行时
grammar.explanation: 过去简单时表示完成的动作，过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作。常连用。
examples: Ted was dancing when someone broke in.
He was drinking when luck struck.

grammar.title: used to do：过去常常做

grammar.title: so...that... 结构

The party was so wild that anything happened.
